bugs.root_cause: No early return/throw for edge case: s == null

bugs.error_message: Profile page shows stale displayName/email after saving and reloading
bugs.root_cause: GET /api/auth/me's userAuthenticationSuccess() read displayName/email from the session/cookie object (set at login time) instead of the freshly-fetched UserDto, even though the fresh DTO was already in scope.
bugs.fix: Changed AuthMeResponse.displayName/email to read from `user.displayName`/`user.email ?: user.username` instead of `session.displayName`/`session.email`.

bugs.error_message: Profile save silently drops the country field; every save fires the PUT twice
bugs.root_cause: Two bugs: (1) ProfilePage.kt (backend) included common.js twice (once via commonScripts(), once explicitly), so the Kotlin/JS profile-save handler registered twice and fired twice per click. (2) The live save path is the Kotlin/JS ProfilePageModule (a hand-written profile.js/api.js pair exists but is dead code, never loaded on this page) whose ApiClientModule.updateProfile(displayName) never accepted a country parameter at all.
bugs.fix: Removed the duplicate script(src="/static/js/common.js") in ProfilePage.kt. Added `country` param to ApiClientModule.updateProfile() and wired ProfilePageModule.saveProfile()/updateProfileUI() to read/send/display #country. Also added `country` to AuthMeResponse so the field populates from a fresh DB read (see bug-007).

bugs.root_cause: Seed data set 6 pets to status='PENDING', a value the Status enum (AVAILABLE/ADOPTED/DISABLED) never defined. Any rescuer owning one of those pets got a hard 500 on /my-pets.
bugs.fix: Changed the 6 seeded pets' status from PENDING to AVAILABLE in test_data.sql (left Status enum unchanged, per user direction — the enum should not model "pending" as a pet status).

bugs.error_message: Temporal Homes city/zip/neighborhood search filters don't trigger a live search
bugs.root_cause: DOMContentLoaded handler only wired a debounced input listener for #search-state; unlike shelters.js/photographers.js/sterilization.js, it never wired #search-city/#search-zip/#search-neighborhood.
bugs.fix: Added the same debounce(window.searchTemporalHomes, 500) input listeners for city/zip/neighborhood, matching the other 3 location-search pages.

bugs.error_message: Editing a pet priced in MXN/ARS/CLP/COP/PEN (or any non-USD/EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD currency) 400s: Failed to convert request body to class UpdatePetRequest
bugs.root_cause: The pet edit/add form's #currency <select> only listed 5 currencies. fillForm() correctly set select.value = pet.currency, but for a pet priced in e.g. MXN there was no matching <option>, so the browser silently left the select at "" (empty string), which failed Currency? enum deserialization on submit.
bugs.fix: Added all 21 currencies from the Currency enum (MXN, ARS, CLP, COP, BRL, PEN, UYU, PYG, BOB, VES, CRC, GTQ, HNL, NIO, DOP, PAB) as options. Note: ProfilePage.kt's #photographerCurrency select has the identical 5-currency gap and was NOT fixed (out of scope for this session).

bugs.error_message: Finland/Uruguay untranslated in all languages; Portuguese country names entirely untranslated
bugs.root_cause: Country.kt's FINLAND/URUGUAY entries used misspelled i18n keys ("country.finnland", "country.uraguay") not matching any language's translation map (this typo was reportedly fixed in a past session but was not present in this branch). Separately, frontend/src/jsMain/kotlin/com/adoptu/frontend/I18n.kt's portugueseTranslations block had zero "country.*" entries at all.
bugs.fix: Fixed the two key spellings in Country.kt. Added all ~112 country-name translations to the Portuguese block in I18n.kt.
